cs.t: I'm not a fan of over the ear cans, so I've gone with in ear monitors (IEMs).  Specifically, Westone 4Rs which are spendy. I've used Westone UM2s as well as assorted Shure models.  In all cases, the tips matter for proper fit and noise isolation - almost all will ship with different types and sizes.  That said, not everyone likes having something in their ear canal. A discussion on tips --  http://www.avforums.com/threads/iem-tip-comparison.1690650/
